questions.q: What is the core distinction between a standard Report and Performance Analytics (PA)?
options: A Report answers 'what does this look like right now'; PA answers 'how has this changed over time'
There is no real distinction — they are the same feature with different names
A Report only works on the incident table; PA works on any table
PA replaces the condition builder; Reports don't use filters
questions.explain: A Report is a live, point-in-time query; PA exists specifically to track trend across time using stored history a live query can't produce.

questions.q: Why can't a standard Report show 'open incidents this week vs. last week'?
options: Reports are not allowed to use the priority field
A Report only ever queries the live table as it exists right now — it has no stored history to look back on
Reports can only show Pie charts, never trend data
This comparison requires a dashboard, not a report
questions.explain: A live query has no memory of what the table looked like last week; only PA's stored snapshots preserve that history.

questions.q: What does a PA collector job actually do?
options: It deletes old records to keep the table small
It runs on a schedule (typically daily) and captures a snapshot — a single frozen value of a KPI at that moment
It builds the dashboard layout automatically
It converts a Report into a Pivot Table
questions.explain: Collector jobs are the mechanism that turns a live number into a permanently stored historical data point.

questions.q: In PA vocabulary, what is an Indicator?
options: A warning icon shown when a report fails to load
The filter condition applied to a report
The KPI itself being tracked, such as 'Number of Open Incidents' or 'SLA Breach Rate'
A button that refreshes a dashboard
questions.explain: An Indicator is the defined KPI that a collector job snapshots on schedule; widgets later display its history.

questions.q: Why is Performance Analytics commonly licensed as a separate add-on from base reporting in many ServiceNow editions?
options: It reflects real additional engineering — collector jobs, a dedicated snapshot store, and a KPI/target framework base Reports don't have
PA and base reporting are actually the exact same underlying feature
Licensing has nothing to do with functionality differences
Base reporting cannot be used without PA installed first
questions.explain: PA's scheduled snapshotting and historical storage are genuinely separate capabilities from the live-query model base Reports use.
